(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* Evaluates fail-safe e-stop circuits, critical over-temperature, and vacuum vessel burst.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;

    (* Fail-safe De-energization of Actuators *)
    bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
    bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;

    (* Drive modulating control valves to calibrated fail-safe isolation limits *)
    rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
    rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;
    rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
    rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
    rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Hardwired Loop Open *)
    iPreviousState := iState;
    iState := 90; (* Jump directly to Fail-Safe Lockdown State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Master Reset Acknowledgment Evaluation *)
IF bMasterReset THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop AND (rVotedBedCoreTemp < c_rMaxBedTemperature) AND (rVotedVacuumPress < c_rMaxCondenserPressure) THEN
        bSystemTrip := FALSE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFF_0000; (* Clear process trips, preserve warnings *)
        IF iState = 90 THEN
            iState := 0; (* Return to POST / Standby Initialization *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* If Latched in Trip State without valid reset, inhibit all downstream automation *)
IF bSystemTrip AND (iState = 90) THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
    bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;
    rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
    rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;
    rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
    rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
    rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

END_IF;

(* --- 2.1 Ambient Relative Humidity 2oo3 Voting --- *)

    IF (rAmbientRH_ChA >= rAmbientRH_ChB AND rAmbientRH_ChA <= rAmbientRH_ChC) OR
       (rAmbientRH_ChA >= rAmbientRH_ChC AND rAmbientRH_ChA <= rAmbientRH_ChB) THEN

    ELSIF (rAmbientRH_ChB >= rAmbientRH_ChA AND rAmbientRH_ChB <= rAmbientRH_ChC) OR

    ELSE
        rVotedAmbientRH := rAmbientRH_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Evaluate Pairwise Cross-Channel Drift *)
    IF (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChA - rAmbientRH_ChB) > c_rTol_RH) OR
       (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChB - rAmbientRH_ChC) > c_rTol_RH) OR
       (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChC - rAmbientRH_ChA) > c_rTol_RH) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: RH Sensor Discrepancy *)
    ELSE

    END_IF;
ELSIF bRH_ChA_OK AND bRH_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChA + rAmbientRH_ChB) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* RH Ch C Failed *)
ELSIF bRH_ChB_OK AND bRH_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChB + rAmbientRH_ChC) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* RH Ch A Failed *)
ELSIF bRH_ChA_OK AND bRH_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChA + rAmbientRH_ChC) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* RH Ch B Failed *)
ELSE
    (* Total Loss of RH Telemetry: Default to Conservative Desert Minimum 12.0% *)
    rVotedAmbientRH := 12.0;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;

    END_IF;
ELSIF bBedTemp_ChA_OK AND bBedTemp_ChB_OK THEN

ELSIF bBedTemp_ChB_OK AND bBedTemp_ChC_OK THEN

(* 3.0 MOF-303 THERMOPHYSICAL & DUAL-SITE LANGMUIR-FREUNDLICH ENGINE                         *)
(* Computes saturation vapor pressures via Magnus-Tetens, affinity parameters, and uptake.   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Magnus-Tetens Saturation Vapor Pressure Formulations:
   P_sat(T) = 6.112 * exp((17.67 * T) / (T + 243.5)) [mbar] *)

(* Ambient Saturation Pressure *)
IF (rAmbientTemp + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressAmbient := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rAmbientTemp) / (rAmbientTemp + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressAmbient := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Ambient Vapor Partial Pressure: P_v = RH * P_sat *)
rVaporPartialPressAmbient := (rVotedAmbientRH / 100.0) * rSatVaporPressAmbient;

(* Bed Saturation Pressure at Current Core Temperature *)
IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressBed := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rVotedBedCoreTemp) / (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressBed := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Condenser Wall Saturation Pressure *)
IF (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressCondenser := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) / (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressCondenser := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Dependent Affinity Constants: b_i = b0_i * exp(DeltaH_ads_i / (R * T)) *)
IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15) > 10.0 THEN
    rAffinity_b1 := c_rb0_1 * EXP((c_rDeltaH_ads1 * 1000.0) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
    rAffinity_b2 := c_rb0_2 * EXP((c_rDeltaH_ads2 * 1000.0) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
    rDynamicLDF_k := c_rLDF_Rate_k0 * EXP((-1.0 * c_rActivationEnergy_Ea) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
ELSE
    rAffinity_b1 := c_rb0_1;
    rAffinity_b2 := c_rb0_2;
    rDynamicLDF_k := c_rLDF_Rate_k0;
END_IF;

(* Dual-Site Langmuir-Freundlich Equilibrium Water Uptake:
   q* = q_sat1 * (b1*P)^n1 / (1 + (b1*P)^n1) + q_sat2 * (b2*P)^n2 / (1 + (b2*P)^n2) *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > 0.05 THEN
    (* Numerical evaluation of term 1 *)
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := c_rQ_sat1 * (rAffinity_b1 * rVotedVacuumPress) / (1.0 + (rAffinity_b1 * rVotedVacuumPress)) +
                                c_rQ_sat2 * (rAffinity_b2 * rVotedVacuumPress) / (1.0 + (rAffinity_b2 * rVotedVacuumPress));
ELSE
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.005;
END_IF;

(* Bound Equilibrium Uptake within MOF-303 Physical Pore Capacity *)
IF rEquilibriumUptake_qStar > 0.480 THEN
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.480;
ELSIF rEquilibriumUptake_qStar < 0.005 THEN
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.005;
END_IF;

(* Linear Driving Force (LDF) Dynamic Depletion Rate: dq/dt = k_LDF * (q* - q) *)
rDesorptionRate_dq_dt := rDynamicLDF_k * (rEquilibriumUptake_qStar - rInstantUptake_q);

(* Numerical Integration of Sorbent Water Loading (dt = 0.1s for 100ms task) *)
IF (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40) THEN
    (* Active Desorption: Water loading depletes *)
    rInstantUptake_q := rInstantUptake_q + (rDesorptionRate_dq_dt * 0.1);
ELSIF (iState = 70) THEN
    (* Nocturnal Adsorption: Mass uptake increases from ambient vapor *)
    rInstantUptake_q := rInstantUptake_q + (0.0035 * (0.450 - rInstantUptake_q) * 0.1);
END_IF;

(* Clamp instantaneous uptake to valid physical limits *)
IF rInstantUptake_q > 0.480 THEN
    rInstantUptake_q := 0.480;
ELSIF rInstantUptake_q < 0.020 THEN
    rInstantUptake_q := 0.020;
END_IF;

rCurrentWaterUptake := rInstantUptake_q;

(* Normalized Desorption Progress (0% to 100%) *)
rBedDesorptionProgress := ((0.440 - rInstantUptake_q) / (0.440 - 0.080)) * 100.0;
IF rBedDesorptionProgress > 100.0 THEN
    rBedDesorptionProgress := 100.0;
ELSIF rBedDesorptionProgress < 0.0 THEN
    rBedDesorptionProgress := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Isosteric Heat of Adsorption Formulation: q_st = DeltaH + RT *)
rIsostericHeat_qst := ((c_rDeltaH_ads1 * 1000.0) / c_rMolarMassWater_M) / 1000.0; (* ~2914 kJ/kg *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MULTI-STAGE CONDENSER & LATENT HEAT RECOVERY HEAT EXCHANGER DYNAMICS                  *)
(* Stage 1: Desuperheating & Latent Preheating | Stage 2: Main Condenser | Stage 3: Trim     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Calculate Log-Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) across Condenser *)
IF (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1 > rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) AND ((rVotedBedCoreTemp - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) > 1.0) THEN
    rCondenserLMTD := ((rVotedBedCoreTemp - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1) + (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1 - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2)) * 0.5;
ELSE
    rCondenserLMTD := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Stage Condenser Thermal Efficiency:
   eta_cond = Q_recovered / (dot_m_vapor * h_fg) *)
IF (rVotedVaporMassFlow > 0.2) AND (rLatentHeatCondensation > 1500.0) THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := (rLatentHeatRecoveryPower / ((rVotedVaporMassFlow / 3600.0) * rLatentHeatCondensation)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 82.5; (* Nominal steady state estimate *)
END_IF;

IF rCondenserThermalEfficiency > 98.0 THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 98.0;
ELSIF rCondenserThermalEfficiency < 10.0 THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 NON-CONDENSABLE GAS (NCG) PURGE & VACUUM SYNCHRONIZATION ENGINE                       *)
(* Evaluates Colburn-Hougen vapor boundary layer diffusion and Dalton partial pressures.    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Dalton's Law: P_total = P_sat_water(T_condenser) + P_NCG
   P_NCG = P_voted_vacuum - P_sat(T_condenser_wall) *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > rSatVaporPressCondenser THEN
    rNCG_PartialPressure := rVotedVacuumPress - rSatVaporPressCondenser;
ELSE
    rNCG_PartialPressure := 0.05; (* Negligible trace gas *)
END_IF;

(* Non-Condensable Gas Molar / Volume Ratio in Condenser [%] *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > 0.1 THEN
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := (rNCG_PartialPressure / rVotedVacuumPress) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rNonCondensableGasRatio > 100.0 THEN
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Colburn-Hougen Diffusion Resistance Factor:
   Gas boundary layer resistance scales nonlinearly with NCG molar fraction:
   Theta_diff = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.18 * (rNonCondensableGasRatio)^1.2) *)
rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 1.0 / (1.0 + (0.18 * rNonCondensableGasRatio));
IF rDiffusionResistanceFactor > 1.0 THEN
    rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 1.0;
ELSIF rDiffusionResistanceFactor < 0.05 THEN
    rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 0.05;
END_IF;

(* Degradation of Overall Condensation Heat Transfer Coefficient *)
rOverallHeatTransferCoeff_U := 2800.0 * rDiffusionResistanceFactor;

(* Vacuum Sync Purge Automation Logic *)
(* Interlock: Only permit purge if purge header vacuum is deeper than condenser chamber *)
bPurgePermitInterlock := (rPurgeLinePressure < (rVotedVacuumPress * 0.75)) OR (rPurgeLinePressure < 25.0);

(* Evaluate Purge Trigger Conditions *)
IF (rNonCondensableGasRatio >= c_rNCG_PurgeTriggerRatio) OR bManualPurgeReq THEN
    IF bPurgePermitInterlock AND NOT tPurgeCooldownTimer.IN THEN
        bPurgeActiveLatched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Timed Pulse Purge Execution (Open purge solenoid for precisely calibrated 3.5 seconds) *)
tPurgeTimer(IN := bPurgeActiveLatched, PT := T#3500MS);
IF tPurgeTimer.Q OR (rNonCondensableGasRatio <= c_rNCG_PurgeClearRatio) THEN
    bPurgeActiveLatched := FALSE;
    tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
    (* Start 15-second inter-purge vacuum stabilization cooldown *)
    tPurgeCooldownTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15000MS);
END_IF;

IF tPurgeCooldownTimer.Q THEN
    tPurgeCooldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

bPurgeValveActive := bPurgeActiveLatched;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION      *)
(* Evaluates discrete state deviation, 1-step prediction, cost gradient and Hessian solver.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Calculate Normalized State Deviation Vector:
   x_dev = [Delta_q, Delta_Tbed, Delta_Pvac, Delta_Tcond, Delta_Pncg, Delta_Qrec]' *)
x1_Dev_q     := rCurrentWaterUptake - rTarget_q;
x2_Dev_Tbed  := rVotedBedCoreTemp - rTarget_Tbed;
x3_Dev_Pvac  := rVotedVacuumPress - rTarget_Pvac;
x4_Dev_Tcond := rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 - rTarget_Tcond;
x5_Dev_Pncg  := rNCG_PartialPressure - rTarget_Pncg;
x6_Dev_Qrec  := rLatentHeatRecoveryPower - rTarget_Qrec;

(* Evaluate 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_next = Ad * x_dev + Bd * u_prev *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_12 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_13 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_14 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_15 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_16 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_11 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_12 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_22 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_23 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_24 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_25 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_26 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_21 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_22 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_32 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_33 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_34 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_35 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_36 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_31 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_32 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_42 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_43 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_44 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_45 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_46 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_41 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_42 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_52 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_53 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_54 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_55 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_56 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_51 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_52 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_62 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_63 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_64 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_65 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_66 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_61 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_62 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);

(* Evaluate Analytical Gradient of Quadratic Cost: g = B' * Q * x_dev *)
(* Control Input 1: Solar Loop Modulation Valve Increment *)
rGrad_u1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_qDev    * x1_Dev_q) +
            (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev * x2_Dev_Tbed) +
            (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev * x3_Dev_Pvac) +
            (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev * x4_Dev_Tcond) +
            (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev * x5_Dev_Pncg) +
            (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev * x6_Dev_Qrec);

(* Control Input 2: Condenser Coolant Modulation Valve Increment *)
rGrad_u2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev    * x1_Dev_q) +
            (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev * x2_Dev_Tbed) +
            (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev * x3_Dev_Pvac) +
            (Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev * x4_Dev_Tcond) +
            (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev * x5_Dev_Pncg) +
            (Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev * x6_Dev_Qrec);

(* Construct 2x2 Projected Hessian Matrix: H = B' * Q * B + R *)
rHess_11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_61 * Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev) +
            rMPC_Weight_dSolar;

rHess_22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_42 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev) +
            rMPC_Weight_dCoolant;

rHess_12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_41 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_61 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev);

(* Determinant of 2x2 Hessian Matrix *)
rDetHess := (rHess_11 * rHess_22) - (rHess_12 * rHess_12);

(* Invert Hessian via Cramer's Rule: Delta_u* = - H^-1 * g *)
IF rDetHess > 0.0001 THEN
    rDelta_u1_Optimal := - ((rHess_22 * rGrad_u1) - (rHess_12 * rGrad_u2)) / rDetHess;
    rDelta_u2_Optimal := - ((rHess_11 * rGrad_u2) - (rHess_12 * rGrad_u1)) / rDetHess;
    bMPC_DegradedFallback := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Fallback: Direct Gradient Descent with Stabilizing Damping *)
    rDelta_u1_Optimal := - 0.08 * rGrad_u1;
    rDelta_u2_Optimal := - 0.08 * rGrad_u2;
    bMPC_DegradedFallback := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Diagnostic: Ill-Conditioned Hessian *)
END_IF;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Limiting & Envelope Clamping *)
(* Solar loop valve: Max +/- 2.5% per 100ms scan (~ 25%/s) *)
IF rDelta_u1_Optimal > 2.5 THEN
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := 2.5;
ELSIF rDelta_u1_Optimal < -2.5 THEN
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := -2.5;
ELSE
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := rDelta_u1_Optimal;
END_IF;

(* Condenser coolant pump: Max +/- 3.0% per 100ms scan *)
IF rDelta_u2_Optimal > 3.0 THEN
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := 3.0;
ELSIF rDelta_u2_Optimal < -3.0 THEN
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := -3.0;
ELSE
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := rDelta_u2_Optimal;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                *)
(* State 0:  POWER-ON SELF-TEST & ISOLATION                                                  *)
(* State 10: METEOROLOGICAL EVALUATION & STANDBY                                             *)
(* State 20: SORPTION BED PRE-EVACUATION & VACUUM SYNC                                       *)
(* State 30: SOLAR-THERMAL DESORPTION RAMP                                                   *)
(* State 40: QUASI-STEADY-STATE HARVESTING & LATENT RECOVERY                                 *)
(* State 50: REGENERATIVE LATENT HEAT TRANSFER                                               *)
(* State 60: BED COOLDOWN & PRESSURE EQUALIZATION                                            *)
(* State 70: AMBIENT NOCTURNAL SORPTION CAPTURE CYCLE                                        *)
(* State 80: HIGH-VACUUM NCG PURGE PULSE                                                     *)
(* State 90: EMERGENCY FAIL-SAFE SHUTDOWN                                                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#7200S);

CASE iState OF
    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: POWER-ON SELF-TEST & ISOLATION                                            *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
        bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;

        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;
        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
        rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

        (* Verify no critical trips exist and basic communications active *)
        IF (dwAlarmWord_1 = 16#0000_0000) AND bEnable THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iPreviousState := 0;
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Meteorological Standby *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: METEOROLOGICAL EVALUATION & STANDBY                                     *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
        bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;

        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 5.0; (* Trickle anti-freeze / anti-stagnation circulation *)
        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
        rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

        (* Decision Engine: Daytime Solar Harvesting vs Nighttime Sorption *)
        IF bEnable THEN
            IF (rFilteredSolarFlux >= c_rMinHarvestSolarFlux) AND (rInstantUptake_q >= 0.180) THEN
                (* Solar thermal flux sufficient and sorbent loaded: Trigger Desorption Prep *)
                iPreviousState := 10;
                iState := 20; (* Bed Pre-Evacuation *)
            ELSIF (rFilteredSolarFlux < 80.0) AND (rVotedAmbientRH >= 10.0) AND (rInstantUptake_q < 0.380) THEN
                (* Nocturnal or dawn condition with ambient moisture: Trigger Sorption Capture *)
                iPreviousState := 10;
                iState := 70; (* Ambient Sorption *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: SORPTION BED PRE-EVACUATION & VACUUM SYNC                               *)
        (* Evacuates non-condensable air from bed chamber before applying desorption heat.   *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
        rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 85.0; (* Open pre-evacuation vacuum port *)
        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 10.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 20.0;

        (* Check vacuum target achieved in bed chamber *)
        IF (rVotedVacuumPress <= 45.0) OR (tStateTimer.ET > T#120S) THEN
            rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0; (* Seal pre-evacuation port *)
            iPreviousState := 20;
            iState := 30; (* Advance to Solar Thermal Desorption Ramp *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: SOLAR-THERMAL DESORPTION RAMP                                           *)
        (* Engages solar thermal circulation loop and preheats MOF-303 matrix.               *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := TRUE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;

        (* Apply MPC modulation with feedforward solar ramp *)
        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := rSolarLoopModulationDuty + rDeltaSolar_Cmd;
        IF rSolarLoopModulationDuty > 100.0 THEN
            rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 100.0;
        ELSIF rSolarLoopModulationDuty < 35.0 THEN
            rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 35.0;
        END_IF;

        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 45.0 + rDeltaCoolant_Cmd;
        IF rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed > 100.0 THEN
            rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed < 15.0 THEN
            rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 40.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 25.0;

        (* Once bed reaches active desorption threshold, advance to steady harvesting *)
        IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp >= c_rMinDesorptionTemp) AND (rVotedVaporMassFlow > 0.8) THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Quasi-Steady Harvesting *)
        END_IF;

        (* Abort ramp if solar flux collapses *)
        IF rFilteredSolarFlux < (c_rMinHarvestSolarFlux * 0.6) THEN
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 60; (* Abort to Cooldown *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: QUASI-STEADY-STATE HARVESTING & LATENT RECOVERY                         *)
        (* Full vapor generation, Stage 1 latent heat transfer, active condensation.        *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := TRUE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
        bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := (rVotedWaterYieldFlow > 0.3);

        (* Full Closed-Loop MPC Optimization of Actuators *)
        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := rSolarLoopModulationDuty + rDeltaSolar_Cmd;
        IF rSolarLoopModulationDuty > 100.0 THEN
            rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 100.0;
        ELSIF rSolarLoopModulationDuty < 15.0 THEN
            rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed + rDeltaCoolant_Cmd;
        IF rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed > 100.0 THEN
            rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed < 20.0 THEN
            rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 85.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 80.0; (* Maximize latent preheating of regenerating bed *)

        (* Check for NCG Accumulation Event requiring Purge Pulse *)
        IF rNonCondensableGasRatio > c_rNCG_PurgeTriggerRatio THEN
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 80; (* Jump to Synchronized Vacuum Purge *)
        END_IF;

        (* Desorption Completion Condition: Sorbent loading depleted below target *)
        IF (rInstantUptake_q <= rTarget_q) OR (rBedDesorptionProgress >= 96.0) OR (tStateTimer.ET > T#5400S) THEN
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 50; (* Advance to Cross-Bed Latent Heat Transfer *)
        END_IF;

        (* Solar Eclipse / Sunset Interlock *)
        IF rFilteredSolarFlux < 150.0 THEN
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: REGENERATIVE LATENT HEAT TRANSFER                                       *)
        (* Exchanges sensible and latent residual energy between spent bed and fresh bed.    *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE; (* Isolate primary solar field *)
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;

        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 30.0;
        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 20.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 100.0; (* Full cross-over flow *)

        (* Execute bed phase rotation after thermal equalization dwell (300 seconds) *)
        IF (tStateTimer.ET > T#300S) OR bForceBedSwitchReq THEN
            (* Rotate 4-bed cycle: Bed 1 -> Cooldown, Bed 2 -> Desorb, Bed 3 -> Adsorb, Bed 4 -> Regen *)
            iBed1_Phase := 3;
            iBed2_Phase := 1;
            iBed3_Phase := 4;
            iBed4_Phase := 2;
            iPreviousState := 50;
            iState := 60; (* Proceed to Bed Cooldown *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: BED COOLDOWN & PRESSURE EQUALIZATION                                    *)
        (* Cools desorbed MOF bed down to ambient temperature to prepare for night uptake.   *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
        bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;

        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 15.0;
        rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
        rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

        (* Bed cooled sufficiently to enter standby or nocturnal adsorption *)
        IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp <= (rAmbientTemp + 8.0)) OR (tStateTimer.ET > T#1800S) THEN
            iPreviousState := 60;
            iState := 10; (* Return to Meteorological Assessment *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: AMBIENT NOCTURNAL SORPTION CAPTURE CYCLE                                *)
        (* Draws hyper-arid nocturnal ambient air through MOF-303 matrix bed for moisture.  *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
        bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := bNightBypassAirDamperPermit;
        bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;

        rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;

        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
